integrity: The scale identity is derived exactly from the published integer matrices. Its auxiliary binary sequence has a fully listed seven-state affine kernel and a proved logarithmic summatory discrepancy. A standalone verifier checks the local-period definition on a finite prefix, all kernel transitions, the doubling identity, and the published dyadic formula.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the leading constant and an O(log log n) error but does not identify the optimal second-order term. The infinite proof treats the published six-dimensional linear representation as a premise.
title: Sharp leading constant for period-doubling periodic complexity
